items.text: Lamar Jackson downgraded to OUT for Sunday vs Bengals with high ankle sprain; third straight miss. Tyler Huntley starts again.
items.why: High ankle sprain; official downgrade Saturday.
items.implication: Huntley starts; fade Ravens pass game ceiling, monitor RB/WR usage under backup QB.
items.opportunity: Potential slight uptick for Ravens RBs in run-heavy script or WRs if garbage time.

items.text: Puka Nacua listed QUESTIONABLE (calf) for Sunday; key DFS/status monitor alongside Lamar and Breece. McVay notes minor but GTD/pregame workout expected.
items.why: Calf issue; left Thursday practice early, DNP Friday. Rapoport: more minor than significant.
items.implication: True GTD ~90 min before 4:25 ET kick; if OUT, heavy run lean + TE/RB targets.
items.opportunity: If OUT: Higbee top-10 TE, Kyren/Corum boost, Parkinson TE1 upside, Mumpfield WR3.

items.text: Breece Hall QUESTIONABLE (quad) after limited practice return; crucial Sunday status for Jets vs Dolphins.
items.why: Quad; limited Thu/Fri after multi-week absence.
items.implication: 50/50 or committee if active; Braelon Allen retains value either way.
items.opportunity: If OUT/INACTIVE: Braelon Allen locked RB1 in great matchup.

items.text: Packers RB Josh Jacobs activated from exempt list and expected to play Sunday.
items.implication: Returns to lead role but rust/workload questions possible; Berry fades post-layoff.
items.opportunity: Full backfield lead if no limits.

items.text: Activated/expected: Christian Kirk (49ers debut), Tank Dell (Texans season debut), Jordan Mason (Vikings), Jonah Coleman (Broncos), Josh Jacobs.
items.implication: Kirk in thin 49ers WR room; Dell debut; Mason committee; Coleman Berry stash love.
items.opportunity: Immediate snaps for Kirk/Dell; monitor Coleman role vs Dobbins/Harvey.

items.text: If Puka OUT: lower Stafford pass yds 10-15, more run-heavy; Kyren/Corum boost, Higbee top-10 TE, Parkinson low-end TE1, Mumpfield ~WR41 lead.
items.implication: Have plan for late window; Puka range WR1 to OUT.

items.text: Saquon Barkley questionable but expected to play Monday vs Cowboys; DeVonta Smith OUT.
items.implication: Berry LOVE if active; elite matchup vs DAL.

items.text: Eagles ruled out WR DeVonta Smith (and Dontayvion Wicks) for Monday Night vs Cowboys.
items.implication: AJ Brown usage spike likely; Goedert/others elevated. Berry had loved DeVonta pre-OUT.
items.opportunity: AJ Brown target share jump; secondary WRs/TEs.

items.text: Lamar/Puka/Breece statuses crucial to Sunday DFS main slate. Sneaky scratches: Brian Robinson, Tyler Warren, Emeka Egbuka important for non-sharps.
items.why: Early news hoped; impacts slate construction.
items.implication: Pivot plans required; Lamar already OUT.

items.text: Brian Robinson OUT; Bijan Robinson expected full bell-cow workload vs SF DvP.
items.why: Hamstring; ruled OUT. Levitan notes Bijan full + SF defense.
items.implication: Bijan massive upgrade to pure workhorse; must-start RB1.

items.text: OUT: Mike Evans, Deebo Samuel, Davante Adams, Rashee Rice, Jeremiyah Love, David Montgomery, Emeka Egbuka, Tyler Warren, Zach Charbonnet, Brian Robinson.
items.implication: Clear benches; elevate handcuffs/backups and teammates.
items.opportunity: Beneficiaries per team (e.g. Bijan, 49ers remaining, etc).

items.text: 49ers dire WR situation (Evans/Deebo/Adams OUT); CMC tempted for more slot WR snaps. Christian Kirk activated for debut. Kittle funnel likely.
items.why: Multiple WR outs; CMC smile on slot question; Kirk activated.
items.implication: CMC routes/targets up; Kittle TE1 funnel; Kirk debut opportunity.
items.opportunity: CMC slot + Kittle targets; Kirk snaps.
items.conflict: Levitan rarely buys RB-as-WR but tempted here.

items.text: IN: Josh Jacobs, Quinshon Judkins, Jordan Addison, TJ Hockenson, others. Confirmed activations align.
items.implication: Full go expected; reverse any prior handcuff boosts.

items.text: LOVE A.J. Brown @ CHI (WR10): back in real role, Bears good for yardage.
items.implication: Strong start; amplified by DeVonta OUT.

items.text: LOVE Tucker Kraft @ DET (TE6): Lions TE buffet, allowed 9 TE TDs.
LOVE Jaylen Warren @ NO (RB9), Chuba Hubbard vs TB (RB10), Bucky Irving @ CAR (RB12): big workloads in friendly matchups.
HATE Rome Odunze vs NE (shadow), Josh Downs @ MIN (low share), Travis Kelce @ SEA (tough D), Josh Jacobs @ DET (post-layoff questions).
items.conflict: Jacobs ACTIVE expected but faded for rust.
